static_dimensions.description: A static categorical attribute of the user that remains fixed during the therapy session with the system. Captures the main present diagnosis and comorbidities or relevant presenting problems/disorders.
A static categorical attribute of the user that remains fixed during the therapy session with the system. Reflects enduring core beliefs, schemas, and habitual thought patterns.
A static categorical attribute of the user that remains fixed during the therapy session with the system. Describes stable personality features, emotional reactivity, and temperament.
A static categorical attribute of the user that remains fixed during the therapy session with the system. Indicates typical coping or avoidance strategies used to manage distress.

A static categorical attribute of the user that remains fixed during the therapy session with the system. Describes age, gender, cultural/ethnic identity, education, occupation, family status, and related context.

A static categorical attribute of the user that remains fixed during the therapy session with the system. Captures the user’s treatment delivery format, setting, prior treatment experience, and preferences.
A static categorical attribute of the user that remains fixed during the therapy session with the system. Includes level of functional impairment and baseline cognitive abilities.
A static categorical attribute of the user that remains fixed during the therapy session with the system. Denotes awareness and understanding of symptoms.
A static categorical attribute of the user that remains fixed during the therapy session with the system. Represents family involvement, typical support patterns, and social context.
A static categorical attribute of the user that remains fixed during the therapy session with the system. Captures trauma history, trauma type, and relevant context.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Captures present emotional tone, predominant mood, and intensity.
options: high negative affect (anxious, sad, irritable, shameful)
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update with discussion of triggers, symptom change, exposure or cognitive tasks, session events, and as the user's affect shifts in response to interventions, stressors, successes, or mindfulness.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Reflects willingness, active participation, and compliance.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update in response to participation with exposure, cognitive tasks, session structure, alliance quality, changes after successes, setbacks, motivational interventions, or reported willingness.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Reflects motivation, readiness to engage, and willingness to practice change.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update as the user expresses willingness, discusses change, responds to motivational interventions, reports on assignment completion, or demonstrates effort with tasks.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Represents the current intensity and pattern of symptoms or subjective distress.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update based on symptom self-report, exposure exercises, therapist observation, rating scales, and session events.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Indicates the frequency and intensity of avoidance or safety behaviors.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update after exposures, behavioral experiments, review of homework, and as the user alters or reflects on coping strategies and response to triggers.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Reflects current ability to reflect, reappraise, and challenge automatic thoughts.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update after cognitive restructuring, insight-building exercises, or as the user discusses shifting perspective on thoughts, emotions, or behaviors.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Captures current intensity or resolution of negative automatic thoughts and distortions.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Changes as the user acquires and applies cognitive skills, insight, new learning, or faces triggering situations.

dynamic_dimensions.dimension_name: Engagement With Therapy Tasks and Adherence
dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Tracks compliance and completion of assigned CBT homework or exposure tasks.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update after homework review, check-ins, therapeutic assignments, or in response to barriers and discussion of supports.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Describes proficiency and independence in using emotion regulation, coping, or CBT skills.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update after skills training, in-session practice, emotional exposures, and as the user reports or demonstrates skill use between sessions.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Denotes which coping strategy is being used most in session.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update as the user avoids, seeks safety, actively participates, resists, or practices acceptance/tolerance, especially during or after exposures or cognitive tasks.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Captures trust, relational quality, and openness to feedback or support.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update with changes after alliance-building, feedback, rupture/repair events, or openness in session.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Reflects current family/support involvement.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update with life circumstance changes, feedback from involved supports, or change in family engagement in rituals or therapy.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Tracks stage of readiness for exposure or behavioral change.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update as the user progresses through therapy, with shifts in self-efficacy, habituation, therapist support, or in the event of setbacks.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Assesses current relapse risk and preparedness for prevention.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update with changes in symptom stability, skill practice, and as therapy termination or transitions are approached.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the therapy session depending on the user's responses and the system's interventions. Reflects the user's medication compliance and attitude.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update as the user discusses side effects, withdrawal, or adjusts reliance on CBT versus medication.
